data: Formal logic has played a key role in development of modern computer science, with applications ranging from architecture, databases, verification to AI and theory of computation. This course will introduce students to proofs and techniques of soundness, completeness and provability in the formal systems. Formal systems introduced in the course include (but are not restricted to) propositional and predicate calculus. It will additionally include some of the resolution theorems from proof theory, which are essential to understand automated theorem proving.
